subject: integration
name: Orivon passwords
summary: The Crypto that answers PASSWORD_0_1 for the browser's own password chooser and fill; no page can call it. It holds no password and connects to nothing: it asks the vault Accounts, the built-in one first. That vault seals each password with the system keyring on this computer, refuses to keep any without a real keyring, and binds a login to its origin; origins and user names are not encrypted on disk. Answers are shape-checked and a call naming an Account never moves to another. An installed vault Account is judged on its own row. Nothing sits above Level 4. Judged here by its publisher.
